record.paper_title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
record.context_brief: Existence, steady states, and local limit for conflict-memory model
record.original_question: Consider the conflict-zone memory model in which populations satisfy ∂_t u_i = d_iΔu_i + γ_i∇·(u_i∇k_i g,R) and the cognitive maps satisfy ∂_t k_i = u_i Σ_j=1^n ρ_ij u_j − (μ + βu_i)k_i. With periodic boundary conditions and a top-hat detection function on a bounded domain, in what sense do time-dependent solutions exist, in what sense do spatially non-constant steady states exist, what qualitative properties do those solutions have, and do the solutions remain well defined as R → 0+?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 10. In what sense do solutions exist solving the time-dependent problem (2.13) subject to periodic boundary conditions and top-hat function in a bounded domain? In what sense do spatially non-constant steady state solutions exist? What are the qualitative properties of these solutions? Do solutions remain well defined in the limit as R → 0+?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ be a bounded domain identified with a flat torus so that all functions are periodic. For $n \geq 2$, consider $n$ population densities $u_i(x,t) \geq 0$ and associated "cognitive map" fields $k_i(x,t) \geq 0$, $i = 1,\dots,n$, satisfying the coupled PDE–ODE system
$$\partial_t u_i = d_i \Delta u_i + \gamma_i \nabla \!\cdot\! \bigl(u_i \, \nabla \langle k_i \rangle_{g,R}\bigr), \qquad x \in \Omega,\ t>0,$$
$$\partial_t k_i = u_i \sum_{j=1}^n \rho_{ij} u_j - (\mu + \beta u_i) k_i,$$
with periodic boundary conditions on $\partial\Omega$ and prescribed nonnegative periodic initial data $u_i(\cdot,0), k_i(\cdot,0)$. Here $d_i>0$, $\gamma_i \in \mathbb{R}$, $\rho_{ij} \in \mathbb{R}$, $\mu>0$, $\beta \geq 0$ are constants, and the nonlocal averaging operator is the top-hat (uniform-disk) detection 
$$\langle k_i \rangle_{g,R}(x,t) = \frac{1}{|B_R|}\int_{B_R(0)} k_i(x+y,t)\,dy,$$
where $B_R(0)$ is the ball of radius $R>0$ centered at the origin (taken modulo the periodic domain).

(a) In what functional-analytic sense (e.g., classical, strong, weak, mild) do global-in-time solutions $(u_i,k_i)$ exist and are unique for this system, and under what regularity/positivity assumptions on the initial data and parameters?

(b) In what sense do spatially non-constant steady-state solutions exist (e.g., via bifurcation from constant equilibria, variational methods, or fixed-point arguments)?

(c) What are the qualitative properties of such time-dependent solutions and non-constant steady states (positivity, boundedness, regularity, asymptotic behavior, pattern structure, stability)?

(d) Do the solutions remain well defined in the singular local limit $R \to 0^+$, in which $\langle k_i \rangle_{g,R} \to k_i$, and if so, in what topology and sense does the family of solutions converge to a solution of the formal local limit system?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem was posed as an open problem in a 2022/2023 survey on PDE models with nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping. Subsequent work (2023–2025) has analyzed related single-species and PDE–ODE memory models, establishing well-posedness, Turing-type instability, and bifurcation results in restricted settings (e.g., one spatial dimension, single species, specific kernels), but a complete answer for the multi-species conflict-zone system with top-hat detection on a bounded periodic domain, including the $R \to 0^+$ local limit, does not appear in the literature. The problem appears to remain open in its full generality.

status_evidence.title: Pattern Formation from Nonlocal Conflict Memory in a PDE-ODE Model
status_evidence.snippet: PDE-ODE hybrid model for a single population moving in response to spatial memory of territorial conflicts; linear stability with top-hat kernel exhibits Turing instability below a critical radius.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on a single-species version of the conflict-memory model.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of a Coupled Nonlocal PDE-ODE System with Spatial Memory
status_evidence.snippet: Well-posedness, stability, and bifurcation analysis for a coupled nonlocal PDE-ODE system with spatial memory.
status_evidence.claim: Related well-posedness and bifurcation results have been established for related models, indicating partial progress.

status_evidence.title: Biological aggregations from spatial memory and nonlocal advection
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and uniqueness of a Hölder continuous weak solution proven in one spatial dimension under general conditions, allowing top-hat kernels.
status_evidence.claim: Well-posedness has been obtained in 1D for related single-species nonlocal memory models.
